summary: Add a shared Quick access follow with explicit reconnect and retained delivery recovery

replay.detail: No stored claims, membership winners or history are rewritten.

schema.detail: Existing arrangement wire and stored contracts are unchanged.

rules.detail: Existing ownership, lifecycle and coordinated reader-readiness requirements remain.

compatibility.detail: New optional shared helper; consuming clients must retain its lifetime across ordinary disconnects and present unconfirmed delivery separately. Existing clients are unchanged.

manual.detail: Refresh reconnects explicitly without resending. Check delivery repeats only the retained original stage using its original identity, key, fence and gateway; fresh edits stay blocked until settled.

recovery.detail: Only matching completed receipts settle ambiguous stages. A definite first-attempt create race may instead validate the reserved live owner/v2 identity; failed validation retains explicit GET-only recovery. Source reads and replay refusals never settle an ambiguous original. State is in memory only, not a durable outbox. No application controls or active writes are enabled by this helper.
